bodies.name: Poslanecká sněmovna Parlamentu České republiky
bodies.layout: A dense, old-style institutional layout dominated by a top logo bar bearing the official Poslanecká sněmovna emblem, followed by a horizontal main menu with multi-level flyout submenus. The homepage body is organized into a three-column grid: a rotating hero/carousel of top stories (Předseda, Sněmovní tisky, Jednání) on the left/center, a running news list (Aktuality) below, and a narrow right-hand sidebar for calendar widgets, session (schůze) status cards, and quick links. The layout is heavily text- and link-dense, reflecting decades-old legacy CMS architecture (URLs still use .sqw query-string routing), with a large collapsible sitemap-style mega-footer listing every subsection. Overall visual density is very high with minimal whitespace and small serif/sans body text typical of a legislative record-keeping site.
ui_patterns: legacy query-string based routing (.sqw endpoints) exposed in all links
multi-level dense dropdown/flyout menu mega-menu
live session status widgets (Svolána/Probíhá/Přerušeno/Ukončeno) for each schůze
embedded calendar grid with colored day-highlighting for sitting weeks
full sitemap replicated in footer (Mapa webu)
livestream links to multiple parallel video channels (Stream 1-5)
accessibility features: skip-to-content links, Czech sign language (znakový jazyk) info page, accessibility statement
official document repositories (sněmovní tisky, stenoprotokoly, digitální repozitář) as core menu items
English-language mirror site link (pspen.psp.cz)

language_samples.context: accessibility skip-link near top of page

bodies.name: Úřad vlády České republiky (Vláda České republiky)
bodies.layout: A modern, image-forward government news portal. The header is a slim white bar with the official 'Vláda České republiky' wordmark/logo (linking home), an EN language switch, and a hamburger-style 'Menu' plus search icon rather than a fully exposed nav bar. The hero area is a large full-width photo of the Prime Minister with a dated caption and headline linking to the full press release. Below the hero, an 'Aktuálně' (Currently) section presents a responsive grid/masonry of recent news cards, each with a photo, headline, and date, echoing a press-office aesthetic more than a legislative-archive one. Further down, dedicated modules highlight the Prime Minister, the government's 'Programové prohlášení' (policy statement), a grid of minister headshot cards with portfolios, a ministries link list, and a 'Důležité dokumenty' document block. The footer is a multi-column 'Patička' mega-footer organized by section (Vláda, Média centrum, Pracovní a poradní orgány, Úřad vlády) plus social links and legal/privacy links.
ui_patterns: large photographic hero banner of the Prime Minister with caption/date
card-based news grid ('Aktuálně') with photo + headline + date + 'Celý článek' link
minister/cabinet member grid with headshot photo, name, and portfolio title
structured document highlight blocks with 'Publikováno [date]' metadata and 'Zjistit více' CTA
EN language switcher in header
official press/media center hub ('Média centrum') separated from general news
multi-column mega-footer ('Patička') organized by top-level section
cookie/privacy and accessibility statement links in footer (Ochrana osobních údajů, Prohlášení o přístupnosti)
RSS feed subscription link

bodies.name: Policie České republiky
bodies.layout: A wide, utilitarian institutional homepage anchored by a strong police-blue color identity matching the Czech police uniform/vehicle livery. The top bar offers accessibility skip-links (přejdi na obsah/hlavní menu/podmenu), a search box, and a 'Rychlé menu' (quick menu) that expands into a full list of regional police headquarters (KŘP) links. A tall horizontal main menu (Úvod, O nás, Útvary Policie ČR, Informační servis, Dopravní servis, Databáze, Nabídky a zakázky, Prevence, eKomunikace, Kontakty) sits below, each with deep multi-item dropdown submenus. The body centers on a 'Zpravodajství' (news) grid of thumbnail-image news cards with dates, followed by an 'INFORMACE' promotional block (recruitment, legal changes, podcast) and a large interactive map-based 'Kontakty' unit locator. The footer stacks quick-link icons (traffic info, missing persons search, official notice boards, victim support), social media icons, sister-site links (Ministry of Interior, Fire Rescue Service), promotional banners, and standard legal/copyright/accessibility/RSS links.
ui_patterns: accessibility skip-links (přejdi na obsah/hlavní menu/podmenu) at page top
expandable 'quick menu' listing all 14 regional police headquarters (KŘP)
deep multi-level dropdown mega-menu across 10 top-level sections
public safety database tools (pátrání po osobách/vozidlech, crime maps, stolen phone/ID registries)
news card grid with thumbnail image, teaser text, and publish date
emergency/tip-line call-to-action banners (158 emergency line, anonymous crime tips)
interactive nationwide map for locating police units/stations
official social media icon row (Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube) in footer
accessibility statement and RSS feed links in footer
text-only ('Textová verze') alternate site version link
